Unity 没有一个稳定通用的项目级自动保存。这个工具会在编辑器里定时保存打开的: This editor tool periodically saves open scenes, Prefab Mode, and project assets.
请先在 Hierarchy 中选中至少一个游戏物体！: Select at least one GameObject in the Hierarchy first.
[清理完成] 在选中的物体中，移除了 {totalRemovedCount} 个: [Cleanup] Removed {totalRemovedCount} missing scripts from {totalAffectedGameObjects} selected GameObjects.
若列表有内容，则优先按该列表作为拆解零件；为空时自动收集。: Use this list as the exploded parts when populated; otherwise collect automatically.
自动收集模式下，是否递归收集全部子节点。: Recursively collect all descendants in automatic mode.
自动收集模式下，是否包含非激活节点。: Include inactive nodes in automatic collection.
每个零件沿质心方向外移的基础距离（米）。: Base outward displacement of each part along its centroid direction (metres).
按零件半径增加的额外位移。开启归一化后，该值表示“最大额外位移（米）”。: Additional displacement based on part radius. With normalization, this is the maximum extra displacement in metres.
是否使用归一化半径计算额外位移。开启后，不会因模型尺寸变大而导致位移过大。: Normalize radii when calculating extra displacement to avoid excessive movement for larger models.
拆解位移最大值（米）。0 表示不限制。: Maximum expansion displacement in metres; 0 means unlimited.
每次切换前是否重新计算目标位姿。若模型结构会动态变化，建议开启。: Recalculate target poses before every switch. Recommended for dynamically changing models.
在此列表指定某些零件的拆解方向与距离规则。列表中的零件会优先使用这里配置的方向。: Override expansion direction and distance rules for listed parts.
为每个零件增加启动延迟，形成分批拆解效果。0 表示同时运动。: Delay each part for staggered expansion; 0 starts all parts together.
强制所有零件同步开始/结束。开启后会忽略 staggerPerPart。: Force all parts to start and finish together, ignoring staggerPerPart.
组装时是否恢复到初始局部旋转。: Restore original local rotation when assembling.
启用后以世界坐标进行位移（推荐）。可避免父级缩放导致位移过小。: Move in world coordinates (recommended) to avoid reduced displacement from parent scaling.

同一父物体下的子教程全部完成后，是否自动关闭整个 ForceTutorial 根: Disable the ForceTutorial root after all child tutorials under the same parent complete.
该强制教程的唯一标识符，必须全局唯一（例如：Tutorial_001）: Globally unique mandatory tutorial identifier, for example Tutorial_001.
是否在游戏一开始就自动触发此教学？（勾选后无需玩家走入触发器即可触发）: Start this tutorial automatically at game startup without entering its trigger.
是否启用进入该强制教程的前置条件判断。启用后，只有当前置条件满足时才允许开始教程: Require prerequisites to be met before starting this mandatory tutorial.
当前前置条件是否已满足。可由外部事件调用下方方法动态修改。: Whether prerequisites are met. External events can update this through the methods below.
是否要求 Interactor 处于指定全局状态后，才允许开始该强制教程。适合: Require a specified Interactor state before starting, such as observation for InsideTutorial.
当启用全局状态条件时，只有 Interactor 进入该状态后才允许开始教程。: Required Interactor state when the global state condition is enabled.
当全局状态条件满足时，是否允许该教程在队列中自动开始。: Allow this queued tutorial to start automatically when its state condition is met.
进入触发器时调用（在这里挂载禁用玩家移动、禁用其余交互的逻辑）: Invoked on trigger entry; bind movement and interaction restrictions here.
教程任务完成时调用（在这里挂载恢复玩家移动、关闭UI面板的逻辑）: Invoked on completion; bind movement restoration and UI closing here.
当玩家进入触发范围、或系统尝试自动启动，但前置条件尚未满足时调用。可用于提示 U: Invoked when entry or automatic start is attempted before prerequisites are met; use for UI or reminders.
【可选】指定 XRBaseInteractor（包含所有射线和直接抓取）。如果未: Optional XRBaseInteractors, including ray and direct interactions. Finds them globally if unassigned.
【可选】玩家的根节点(XR Origin)。如果未设置，将自动通过 Locomo: Optional player root (XR Origin). Found through LocomotionSystem when unassigned.

当前步骤要显示的教程文本: Tutorial text displayed for this step.
是否为【强制交互】步骤？\n如果勾选：该步骤不会自动推进，必须由正确输入或外部交: Require interaction: advance only on accepted input or an external CompleteAction() call. Otherwise advance after the configured delay.
当步骤为【强制交互】时，可在这里直接配置允许推进教程的输入。\n支持按钮与摇杆方: Inputs that advance a mandatory step, including buttons and stick directions. Leave empty for external CompleteAction() calls.
勾选后，本步骤需要先按住下方按钮，再执行 acceptedButtons 中配置: Require the modifier below to be held while performing an acceptedButtons input.
组合输入模式下，需要保持按住的按钮。\nacceptedButtons 则填写真: Held modifier for combined input; acceptedButtons contains the direction/button that advances the step.
该步骤需要开放到什么程度的玩家输入。\n推荐你为每一步明确指定状态。Button: Allowed player input for this step. ButtonOnly enables buttons/interactions without pose movement. Unmodified legacy settings use FullyBlocked.
进入该步骤时触发的事件: Event invoked when entering this step.
可用于：进入该步骤时执行特定操作。\n例如：如果这是强制交互步骤，在这里解开玩家: Bind step-entry behavior, such as restoring selected grabbing or button interactions for a mandatory step.
【可选】如果指定了 Transform，该步骤的 UI 将固定在此位置和朝向，不: Optional fixed UI position and orientation for this step, replacing camera following.
整个教程界面的根节点（通常就是当前Canvas的第一个子物体，用于自动显示/隐藏: Tutorial UI root, usually the Canvas first child, used for automatic visibility.
是否让 UI 始终跟随并朝向主摄像机？: Keep the UI following and facing the main camera.
UI 距离玩家摄像机的保持距离（建议设为 1.0 ~ 1.5）: Distance from the player camera; recommended 1.0-1.5.
UI 的高度偏移（建议稍微偏下一点，如 -0.1，避免完全挡住正前方视线）: UI height offset; a slight downward offset such as -0.1 keeps the forward view clear.
UI 旋转和位置跟随的平滑速度（值越小跟随越有延迟感，建议设为 5）\n如果设为: UI pose-follow smoothing speed; lower values lag more (recommended 5). Zero or very large values snap immediately.
非强制交互步骤自动进入下一步的等待时间（秒）: Automatic advance delay for presentation steps, in seconds.
播放强制教程时，临时将本教程相关 Canvas 提到更前面，避免被普通教程菜单遮: Temporarily raise tutorial canvases above ordinary tutorial menus during mandatory steps.
强制教程临时使用的排序层级。数值越大，渲染越靠前。: Temporary mandatory tutorial sorting order; larger values render in front.
进入带有教程输入配置的强制步骤后，等待多久才开始接受按键/摇杆判定。: Delay before accepting button/stick input after entering a configured mandatory step.
教程开始时触发（在这里挂载：完全禁用玩家所有操作/移动）: Invoked on tutorial start; bind player input/movement restrictions here.
教程全部结束时触发（在这里挂载：恢复玩家所有操作、隐藏UI等）: Invoked after all steps finish; restore player input and hide UI here.
玩家在强制交互阶段执行了【错误操作】时触发（可配置播放错误提示音等）: Invoked on incorrect input during mandatory interaction; can play an error sound.
错误提示文本默认显示时长。若玩家在此期间完成了正确操作，会立即中断并进入下一步。: Error-message duration. Correct input interrupts the message and advances immediately.
拖入 ForceTutorial.inputactions 资源，脚本会自动读取: Assign ForceTutorial.inputactions to load its button and stick actions.
组件启用后，延迟多久再开始监听输入，避免刚启用时误触发: Delay input listening after enable to prevent accidental activation.
每次成功处理一个教程输入后，等待多久再允许处理下一次输入: Delay between successfully handled tutorial inputs.
摇杆方向判定阈值，超过这个值才视为一次有效拨动: Stick direction threshold for a valid input.
当玩家在强制教程中输入正确的移动/转向操作时，自动追加一小段位移或转向，让反馈更: Add a small movement or rotation after correct locomotion input to make feedback clearer.
移动教学步骤中，额外追加的位移距离。: Additional displacement during movement tutorial steps.
移动教学反馈持续时长。值越小，额外位移越利落。: Movement feedback duration; shorter values produce quicker displacement.
转向教学步骤中，额外追加的转向角度。: Additional rotation angle during turning tutorial steps.
